answer.evidence: Bad splice at SC-03 (route 10.723km; fibre 10.99km from A after 1km launch minus excess/slack). Rx stepped -12.1 to -13.4dBm on 24 Oct, ~1h after SC-03 re-entered 06:52 for branch work. OTDR bidirectional: ~1.3dB non-reflective loss at SC-03 at 1310, 1550 and 1625nm in both directions (true loss ~1.31dB) - wavelength-independent, so not a macrobend (would be >> at 1550/1625). Trace shows clean step without reflection. Tx output 1.32dBm in spec with flat Pm Tx/bias, attenuator 10.16dB vs 10dB design, A/B-ODF connectors clean with normal reflectance, fibre not broken (service up, end seen). SC-02 apparent 0.68dB one-way is G.652/G.655 MFD gainer: -0.57/-0.64 reverse, bidirectional ~0.05dB normal. Rain at km6 occurs after onset and no event there.

args.evidence: Bad splice at SC-03 (route 10.723km; fibre 10.99km from A after 1km launch minus excess/slack). Rx stepped -12.1 to -13.4dBm on 24 Oct, ~1h after SC-03 re-entered 06:52 for branch work. OTDR bidirectional: ~1.3dB non-reflective loss at SC-03 at 1310, 1550 and 1625nm in both directions (true loss ~1.31dB) - wavelength-independent, so not a macrobend (would be >> at 1550/1625). Trace shows clean step without reflection. Tx output 1.32dBm in spec with flat Pm Tx/bias, attenuator 10.16dB vs 10dB design, A/B-ODF connectors clean with normal reflectance, fibre not broken (service up, end seen). SC-02 apparent 0.68dB one-way is G.652/G.655 MFD gainer: -0.57/-0.64 reverse, bidirectional ~0.05dB normal. Rain at km6 occurs after onset and no event there.

evidence_refs.quote: Splicing crew re-entered closure SC-03 to add a branch cable for a new customer. Closure resealed.
